command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture complete Type 13 output before and after an approved reboot, retain raw representations, parse the full list and compare under the approved encoding/order policy.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All four source field groups, reboot persistence and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Store a counted raw language list plus normalized comparison view, flags, reserved bytes and current-language membership with decoder/boot provenance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds full list semantics and raw-preserving normalization rather than a header snippet.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects truncated lists, invalid current-language selection, encoding drift and changed reserved/flag data.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Locale aliases and ordering can differ without semantic change; only the approved normalization policy may treat them as equivalent.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC must define exact allowed languages, ordering/alias rules and reserved-field acceptance; this row does not authorize setting a different language.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure, criteria and script consistently target Type 13 language metadata and reboot persistence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The language policy, decoder and reboot controls are finite inputs; absence delays execution rather than review.

review_improvement: Prevents a single grepped line from passing the counted language list, raw reserved values and active-language relationship.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Type 13 result is internally relational: Current Language should be valid within the installable list, while flags and reserved bytes require raw preservation. A one-line read cannot establish that. Collection can be automated, but reboot authorization makes REQUIRES correct.
